mapper.select:
select avg(r.score) from meal_review r where r.del_flag = '0'
and r.dept_id = #{deptId}

select d.status as status, count(*) as cnt from meal_dish d where d.del_flag = '0'
and (d.dept_id = 0 or d.dept_id = #{deptId})
group by d.status

select sum(case when d.dept_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as public_cnt, sum(case when d.dept_id <> 0 then 1 else 0 end) as family_cnt from meal_dish d where d.del_flag = '0'
and (d.dept_id = 0 or d.dept_id = #{deptId})

select count(*) from meal_category c where c.del_flag = '0'
and (c.dept_id = 0 or c.dept_id = #{deptId})
select count(*) from meal_app_version v where v.del_flag = '0'

select count(*) from meal_proposal p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0'
and p.dept_id = #{deptId}

select count(*) from meal_order d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0'
and d.dept_id = #{deptId}
select count(*) from meal_order d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from meal_proposal p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.user_id = #{userId}
